segments.say: Answered, with the sheet. NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra on Nebius Token Factory answered from the index. Nemotron 3 Nano Omni read the sheet on a Nebius AI Cloud endpoint. The boxes are the lettering it relied on.
Fifty-five thousand public-domain drawing sets at the Library of Congress. Still read sheet by sheet. None could be asked a question. Until now.
Iolani Palace, Honolulu, HABS number H I one: eighty-five pages, twenty-three drawing sheets, fifty-seven photographs.
Nano Omni read every sheet on one L40S on Nebius AI Cloud: every piece of hand lettering with its position. 1,818 entries, read by the model, not typed by us.

Which sheets show the Richards Street elevation. Ultra answers from the evidence pack with the sheets as receipts, verified in code: a page that does not exist is flagged, every quoted span must be on the page it cites.
What does sheet 12 reference. Historic sheets cross-reference by lettering, SEE SHEET N. We type those into links, so the answer carries the lettering as its receipt.

do.text: what wood species is the central stair balustrade

segments.say: And the question every archive tool gets wrong. What wood is the stair balustrade. The set does not say, so Nemotron answers: not in the set, with the pages it checked. Four outcomes, nothing else.

do.text: what are the walls built of

segments.say: Lahaina, August eighth, 2023. The Old Lahaina Courthouse burned to its walls. HABS measured it in 1966. Same pipeline, Nemotron 3.5 Super-VL reading on Token Factory. What are the walls built of? Coral, twenty-one inches thick. The walls that stood. Ask about 2023, and it says: not in the set.
Open method on open models: MIT on GitHub, public-domain documents from loc dot gov. Live on Hugging Face Spaces, link in the description.
Nemotron on Nebius reads it today. Next, we train the eyes on Token Factory. Nothing invents a sheet.
